en.headline: Composer Olivier Cong presents coral soundscape at L’ÉCOLE tonight
en.dek: The free Magic Hour event at the School of Jewelry Arts in K11 MUSEA runs from 6pm to 9pm as part of the ongoing Precious Coral exhibition, with registration required.
body: Hong Kong composer Olivier Cong will lead a live soundscape performance drawing on coral specimens this evening at L’ÉCOLE, School of Jewelry Arts in K11 MUSEA, Tsim Sha Tsui.

Titled “The Sound of Coral”, the session forms part of the Magic Hour series accompanying the Precious Coral exhibition. Participants can view coral, branches, specimens and beads while on-site recording equipment captures subtle sounds of movement; Cong then incorporates those sounds into an evolving live performance against the backdrop of Victoria Harbour at sunset.

The event runs from 6pm to 9pm on Friday 11 September. Admission is free but registration is required. The exhibition itself continues until 11 October and examines coral through biology, craftsmanship and history, featuring jewellery and specimens from various collections.

zh.headline: 江逸天今晚於L’ÉCOLE以珊瑚標本演繹聲景
zh.dek: K11 MUSEA珠寶藝術學院「日落雅聚」系列活動今晚6時至9時舉行，免費但須預先登記，配合《深珊瑚》展覽。
body: 香港作曲家江逸天今晚於尖沙咀K11 MUSEA的L’ÉCOLE珠寶藝術學院，以珊瑚標本為題帶領現場聲景演出。
活動名為「聽見海洋的沉寂與律動」，屬配合《深珊瑚》展覽的「日落雅聚」系列。參加者可近距離觀看珊瑚、枝幹、標本及珠粒，現場收音器材捕捉移動時的細微聲響，再由江逸天即時加入演奏，交織成不斷變化的聲景，並以維港日落為背景。
活動於9月11日周五下午6時至晚上9時舉行，免費入場但須預先登記。展覽本身展至10月11日，從生物學、工藝及歷史角度探討珊瑚，展出珠寶作品及標本。
